messages:
Jules: Heads-up: mid-quarter compliance review next Wed (2026-05-12). We need a brief release freeze window to complete evidence collection.

Priya: What timeframe are we talking about?

Jules: Freeze window = 06:009:00 PT on Wed. This is read-only for non-critical deploys; emergency security fixes allowed with approval.

Ken: Will canaries still run?

Jules: No canaries during the freeze. Autoscale and infra monitoring continue. Post-freeze we do a guarded canary at 11:00 PT with 5% traffic for 1h.

ops-bot: Note: maintenance-window created release/freezemidq-2026-05-12 by Jules. Notifications queued to #customer-communications.

Priya: Any change to rollback or incident contact procedures during freeze?

Jules: Rollback rules unchanged. Escalation: page oncall -> then platform lead. If you must ship a hotfix, DM me + attach approval ticket (JIRA-OPS-XXXX).

platform-team: Addendum: DB schema migrations banned during freeze unless preapproved. Use online feature flags if you need behavior changes.

Priya: Confirming: all non-security PRs targeting next deploy will be gated?

Jules: Correct. We'll gate in the release tracker and defer to next Tue/Thu slot.

comms: We'll send tenant notice: 72h email + in-console banner 24h before. Team please flag any customers that must be excluded.

Ken: Small infra patch (logging rotation) is low-risk, can we get exception?

Jules: @Ken open approval ticket and tag me. If approved, ops-bot will mark exception.

Priya: Quick checklist request: can we get a short ops checklist to follow for freeze?

Jules: Yep, publishing checklist in 30m. Key items:
- register any in-flight backfills and pause them
- pause scheduled chaos tests and A/B experiments
- verify nightly backups completed
- confirm oncall coverage and contact numbers
- disable auto-deploy merge queue

ops-bot: Checklist published: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/freeze-checklist (internal)

platform-team: Acks: we will pause canary autoscaler and hold the rollout queue.

Ken: Ack. Will open approval ticket for logging change.

Priya: Ack. Communicating to my squad.

Jules: Thanks. If you have any urgent blockers DM me. We'll lift the freeze at 09:00 PT and start the guarded canary at 11:00 PT. :white_check_mark:
